parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance whose name or description you want to update.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description:
The new name of the instance. The name must meet the following rules:

*   The name of the instance must be unique in the region where the instance is deployed.
*   The name must be 3 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (\_), and Chinese characters.
*   If you do not configure this parameter, the instance name remains unchanged.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The updated description of the instance. If you do not configure this parameter, the instance description remains unchanged.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ons ons-instance-update --remark '备注更新' --instance-name '名字更新' --instance-id MQ_INST_1880770869020000_BXSuW61e --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ons OnsInstanceUpdate --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceName '名字更新' --InstanceId MQ_INST_1880770869020000_BXSuW61e --Remark '备注更新'
